title: Native direct Windows witness stalls during WSL-path CMake configure
body: The required queued native CPU witness invoked tools/vixen-native.sh --direct against the assigned WSL worktree and reached the Windows configure phase, but .tmp/platscope1-native/CMakeFiles/CMakeConfigureLog.yaml stopped advancing for 33 minutes; retrying with documented VIXEN_SKIP_BUILD_LOCK=1 stalled for 10 more minutes. The facade/tooling should provide a native witness route that materializes or validates a fast Windows-native source/build path and surfaces configure progress/diagnostics, so a lane does not need to manually terminate an opaque queued process.
